notes: Recorded answers of the fictional sensitive-content model used by the offline evaluation, the tests and the demo. They deliberately include one low-confidence guess, one quote that is not in the source, one entry with an unknown flag_type and one flag on a context segment, so the pipeline's drop rules are exercised. Objects are serialised to JSON text by the replay client; the c-103 answer is kept as a code-fenced string to exercise answer extraction.
